```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

#loading reuseable cleaning functions 
source("R/01_funct_DataCleaning.R")
```

# Importing the SCF datasets

```{r}
scf_have <- read.csv("Data/Raw/SCF/interactive_bulletin_charts_racecl4_have.csv")

scf_mean <- read_csv("Data/Raw/SCF/interactive_bulletin_charts_racecl4_mean.csv")

scf_median <- read_csv("Data/Raw/SCF/interactive_bulletin_charts_racecl4_median.csv")
```

#Importing the dfa datasets

```{r}
dfa_levels <- read_csv("Data/Raw/DFA/dfa-race-levels.csv")

dfa_levels_detail <- read_csv("Data/Raw/DFA/dfa-race-levels-detail.csv")

dfa_shares <- read_csv("Data/Raw/DFA/dfa-race-shares.csv")

dfa_shares_detail <- read_csv("Data/Raw/DFA/dfa-race-shares-detail.csv")
```

# Understanding the datasets

#examining scf datasets

```{r}
glimpse(scf_have)
glimpse(scf_mean)
glimpse(scf_median)

```

#checking the dimensions

```{r}
dim(scf_have)
dim(scf_mean)
dim(scf_median)
```

#examining dfa datasets

```{r}
glimpse(dfa_levels)
glimpse(dfa_levels_detail)
glimpse(dfa_shares)
glimpse(dfa_shares_detail)

```

#checking the dimensions

```{r}
dim(dfa_levels)
dim(dfa_levels_detail)
dim(dfa_shares)
dim(dfa_shares_detail)

```

#checking for missing values and duplicates

```{r}
all_datasets <- list(scf_have = scf_have, scf_mean = scf_mean, scf_median = scf_median, dfa_levels = dfa_levels, dfa_levels_detail = dfa_levels_detail, dfa_shares = dfa_shares, dfa_shares_detail = dfa_shares_detail)

```

#checking for missing values and duplicates

```{r}
lapply(all_datasets, check_missing)


```

```{r}
check_duplicates(scf_have, c("year", "Category"))
check_duplicates(scf_mean, c("year", "Category"))
check_duplicates(scf_median, c("year", "Category"))

check_duplicates(dfa_levels, c("Date", "Category"))
check_duplicates(dfa_levels_detail, c("Date", "Category"))
check_duplicates(dfa_shares, c("Date", "Category"))
check_duplicates(dfa_shares_detail, c("Date", "Category"))
```

```{r}
lapply(all_datasets, check_categories)
```

# checking the years and dates on the datasets

```{r}
sort(unique(scf_have$year))
sort(unique(scf_mean$year))
sort(unique(scf_median$year))

sort(unique(dfa_levels$Date))
sort(unique(dfa_levels_detail$Date))
sort(unique(dfa_shares$Date))
sort(unique(dfa_shares_detail$Date))



```
